summary: Findings A1-A8 of /home/claude/cpt-studio-ux-20261103/refute-r3/results.json (lens A), each REPRODUCED by a verifier (verdicts verify3:A:<id>) and reproduced again on this branch's base e020145e1 (scratch-r3-reader/out/rows-base.json: every finding input in the 'R8 R3 ' rows below reads as the finding says). A1, A2, A6 and A7 were introduced by the round-2 repairs (de78c63e8); A3, A4 and A5 are pre-existing on c47d71a34 and worse than installed; A8 is pre-existing on the installed revision too. Each rule below reads structure the document already gives (a note label, a label's own definitions, the examination an instrument tells, the lesion a sentence refers back to) and holds where the document does not settle the reading; where a repair gives an act back to the service the document gives it (the installed reading, or c47d71a34's for the round-2 repairs' own regressions), the release is named here, row by row.

standard: Refutation round 3's brief: the head must never read a document worse than the installed revision 41e03656d does (a code READY that installed holds, a supported code held or excluded that installed made READY, an E/M question dropped that installed asked), and must keep the round-2 repairs' declared improvements; where a narrower rule cannot do both, the shape reads as installed does. Round-4 (ruling 2026-11-03 (g); R8 section 4): when the document does not settle a reading, hold or ask - never release, never exclude a supported code. Every earlier repair stays (Mara's acceptance; every declared row of cux-bind.json, cux-hold.json, cux-lead.json, cux-r2-bind.json, cux-r2-em.json and cux-r2-variants.json). Any movement not declared below is a finding, measured and amended (dated, after code) before it is accepted.

findings.A1: blocking against this branch's own repair (de78c63e8, L1c; equal to installed): 'Procedure 2:', 'Subsequent procedure:' and 'Follow-on procedure:' over R8 D7's same-day flexible sigmoidoscopy note open no note part, so the note's rectal biopsy is the colonoscopy's: 45380 READY, 45331 held (c47d71a34: 45380 held, 45331 READY).
findings.A2: blocking against this branch's own repair (R1c; equal to installed): 'No snare was used on COL-2, just above the rectosigmoid junction.' (also '... in the left colon.', 'No forceps were used on COL-1 near the hepatic flexure.') unbinds the label, so the genuine same-lesion conflict is lost: 45385 READY (c47d71a34: held [conflict:snare]).
findings.A3: blocking, worse than installed (pre-existing on c47d71a34): in a combined report's one narrative, '(specimen 1)' (and 'the same cold forceps used to retrieve COL-1') after 'The gastroscope was advanced ...' binds the upper endoscopy's biopsy to the colon lesion: 45380 READY on a gastric biopsy (installed: held).
findings.A4: blocking, worse than installed (pre-existing on c47d71a34): after a separate flexible sigmoidoscopy note, 'A 5 mm polyp was seen in the cecum. It was removed with a cold snare.' leaves the snare the note's: 45338 READY beside 45378, 45385 held (installed: 45385 READY, 45338 held).
findings.A5: major, worse than installed (pre-existing on c47d71a34): 'An evaluation for new-onset jaundice was performed today.' (and its postmodified kin) beside Mara's absence sentence misses cues.EM_EVALUATION_STATED, so the visit reads negated and 99213 is EXCLUDED (installed: the E/M questions asked, 99213 held).
findings.A6: major, introduced by de78c63e8 (L1d; and the same class through L1f): a colonoscopy report's header line 'Additional procedure: EGD performed today (separate report)' ends the colonoscopy's claim on its own narrative after it, so its snare and biopsy are held act_missing (installed and c47d71a34: READY).
findings.A7: major, introduced by de78c63e8 (R1b): a specimen row restating 'COL-2: 8 mm polyp' without its site leaves COL-2 unresolved, so 'No biopsy forceps were used on COL-2.' becomes a site-less denial and holds 45380 (and the COL-1 form holds 45385); c47d71a34: READY.
findings.A8: pre-existing on installed, re-graded blocking by its verifier: R8 D8's indication line written with a dash ('Indication - surveillance after a sigmoid polyp was removed with a hot snare') is no indication section of routing's layout (sections._heading reads no colon-less line over 60 characters), so V05 never reads it and 45385 is READY. Its repair needs sections.layout (H2-frozen: gi-context@4): measured and recorded as a residual, not changed (the brief).

rules.L1c-r3: services.LABELLED_NOTE (A1): 'subsequent' and 'follow-on' modifiers and a numbered 'Procedure N' label are note labels again, as on c47d71a34, beside R10b's 'Separate same-day note:'. The round-2 shapes they were narrowed for stay held by the rules that already read them: F01's plan and history lines by L1a, F01's heading line by L1b (no title reading, no act on a procedure line), F03's numbered lists by the list rule (a labelled line beside another one naming a service opens no part), and one numbered line over a combined report's shared findings by L1f. A same-day note under 'Procedure 2:', 'Subsequent procedure:' or 'Follow-on procedure:' owns its acts as one under 'Separate note:' does (R8 D7).
rules.L1d-r3: services.parts() (A6): a part of no family that a note label line began - L1d's after a refused label, and L1f's where a labelled part's text turns to the examination of the part the label interrupted - ends at a line that tells the interrupted (running) part's own examination by its instrument: that family's instrument and no other family's (INSTRUMENTS / INSTRUMENT_FAMILY, as L1f reads them; a bare 'endoscope' names none), on a line with no negation, hedge, cancellation, plan or history word. From that line the running part goes on (its family and kind), as before the label. A note's own instrument (R10's sigmoidoscope), two families on one line, a denial of the running instrument ('The colonoscope was not reinserted.') and a combined report's labelled part (no running family) change nothing.
rules.L1e-r3: services._build pass 3 (A4): in a part a note label opened, a sentence that names no lesion of its own and refers back to one (ANAPHORA: 'It was removed ...', 'The polyp was removed ...') refers to the last lesion named in that part; where that lesion was placed beyond the note's reach (L1e: by the part the label interrupted), the sentence's acts that name no site are placed with it - by that part's service, at that lesion - as installed reads them. Elsewhere the reference reads as before (the last lesion of the part's family). An act naming a site keeps L1e's own reading.
rules.R1a-r3: services._build pass 3 (A3, P1 rule 1): where an act's part, its sentence's named service and the one procedure give it no family, a label or specimen reference binds an act its own clause does not deny only where the last instrument told before the act (INSTRUMENTS / INSTRUMENT_FAMILY; a bare 'endoscope' names none) is not one of another service told after the bound lesion's own passage: otherwise the act reads as before rule 1 (placed by its own site, or, in a combined report's part, by none - rule 4's reading). A denial bound by its label keeps the binding: the label names the lesion it denies (Mara's 'No biopsy forceps were used on COL-2.'), whatever examination was told before it.
rules.R1b-r3: services._label_definitions / _unique_labels (A7, P1 rule 1): a label defined on more than one line, some naming no site, resolves (to the place its sited definitions name, by the existing compatibility check) where every site-less definition restates the lesion: no two definitions give different sizes, and the site-less definition is told in no context of another tract - the report part it lies in (that family's reach, FAMILY_REGIONS), the heading of routing's layout section it lies in (a site of an incompatible region) and, for a definition giving no size, the last instrument told before it (that family's reach; a family of unknown reach contradicts). Otherwise, as R1b: the label resolves to nothing (F04c's 'P1: a 9 mm sessile polyp.' under 'Stomach:'). A specimen table's 'COL-2: 8 mm polyp' after 'COL-2 - sigmoid colon: An 8 mm ...' restates COL-2.
rules.R1c-r3: services._bound_lesion / _build pass 3 (A2, P1 rule 1): where R1c unbinds a label because the act's clause names a site of the lesion's own tract that is neither its site nor its region's whole, and the clause denies or cancels the act, the denial is read both ways: placed by its own site as R1c reads it (F06's conflict at that site kept), and also bound to the labelled lesion as c47d71a34 read it (a second statement of the same denial at that lesion, in the lesion's own service, subject to R1a and rule 1's own checks), so a genuine same-lesion conflict is kept as well. An act the clause states done stays unbound (R1c, as installed); services._same_subject is unchanged (rule 7).
rules.R8b-r3: cues.EM_EVALUATION_STATED (A5; R8b-2's declared form): a history, history and physical or examination, H&P, evaluation, assessment, consultation or consult performed, obtained, taken, done, completed, conducted, carried out, elicited, held, provided, undertaken or documented is also read with a postmodifier between the noun and its verb, where the noun heads its sentence (an optional opener 'Today,', 'Separately,', 'Also,', 'Additionally,'; an optional 'a' or 'an'; at most three adjectives of a closed list) and the postmodifier is 'for', 'regarding', 'concerning', 'about' or 'addressing' <...>, or 'of her|his|their|the patient's|this patient's <...>', up to 80 characters with no sentence break ('An evaluation for new-onset jaundice was performed today.', 'An assessment of her new-onset jaundice, a separate problem, was documented today.'). Read only by detect._em_evaluation_stated, only to hold the absence statement (a closed list that only adds holds). 'Biopsies for evaluation of ...' (the noun heads no sentence), 'An assessment of the gastric mucosa ...' ('of' an organ) and 'will be performed' are not read.
